markets.rules_primary: If neither team wins and the game ends in a tie in the Miami vs Minnesota Pro Football game originally scheduled for Oct 4, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
If one of the teams wins the Miami vs Minnesota Pro Football game originally scheduled for Oct 4, 2026, then the market resolves to No. Otherwise, if the game ends in a tie, the market will resolve to Yes. If the game is postponed but begins within 48 hours from its originally scheduled start time, the market will remain open and resolve based on the official final result. If the game is not started within 48 hours, the market will resolve to a fair price.
